target.model: Vacuum Schwarzschild interior via Kantowski-Sachs WDW minisuperspace
target.scope_note: Audit the path from the verified classical Schwarzschild/KS bridge to clock choice, physical inner product, factor ordering and mass/curvature observables without treating minisuperspace consistency as full quantum gravity. This target is permanently minisuperspace-scoped and cannot be promoted to full quantum GR even if every internal gate passes.

interpretation_rule: Labels describe only passed scoped gates. A blocking PENDING/PARTIAL/FAIL forces PHYSICAL INTERPRETATION NOT IDENTIFIED. A hard minisuperspace scope ceiling remains even if every internal gate passes and forbids promotion to full quantum GR.

omitted_degrees_of_freedom: generic inhomogeneous metric and matter modes
the full spatially local Hamiltonian constraints H_perp(x)
the full spatially local diffeomorphism constraints H_i(x)
the quantum Dirac/constraint algebra and its anomaly-closure problem
scope_ceiling.note: All internal gates may pass while this ceiling remains. The repository quantizes a symmetry-reduced homogeneous minisuperspace after discarding local field degrees of freedom; completion of the reduced theory cannot by itself establish full quantum general relativity.
